refnamediv.refpurpose: APIs for acquiring cloud IMDS information.

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.InstanceMetadata is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.
APIs for acquiring cloud IMDS information.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# APIs for acquiring cloud IMDS information. interface io.systemd.InstanceMetadata
# Well known data fields type WellKnown( base, hostname, region, zone, ipv4_public, ipv6_public, ssh_key, userdata, userdata_base, userdata_base64 )
# Acquire data. method Get( # The key to retrieve key: ?string, # Start with a well-known key wellKnown: ?WellKnown, # The network interface to use interface: ?int, # Refresh cached data if older (CLOCK_BOOTTIME, µs) refreshUSec: ?int, # Whether to accept cached data cache: ?bool, # The firewall mark value to use firewallMark: ?int, # Controls whether to wait for connectivity wait: ?bool, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( # The data in Base64 encoding. data: string, # The interface the data was found on. interface: ?int )
# Get information about cloud vendor and IMDS connectivity. method GetVendorInfo() -> ( # The detected cloud vendor vendor: ?string, # The URL to acquire the token from tokenUrl: ?string, # The HTTP header to configure the refresh timeout for the token in refreshHeaderName: ?string, # The base URL to acquire the data from dataUrl: ?string, # A suffix to append to the data URL dataUrlSuffix: ?string, # The HTTP header to pass the token in when requesting data tokenHeaderName: ?string, # Additional HTTP headers to pass when acquiring data extraHeader: ?[]string, # IPv4 address of IMDS server addressIPv4: ?[]int, # IPv6 address of IMDS server addressIPv6: ?[]int, # Well-known fields wellKnown: ?object )
# The requested key is not found on the IMDS server. error KeyNotFound()
# IMDS is disabled or otherwise not available. error NotAvailable()
# IMDS is not supported. error NotSupported()
# Well-known key is not set. error WellKnownKeyUnset()
# Communication with IMDS failed. error CommunicationFailure()
# Timeout reached error Timeout()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.InstanceMetadata shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.InstanceMetadata.Get '{}' invokes its Get method.
